items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the stalk of the presheaf represented by an object as the value of the functor defining the point at that object (statement lines 8135-8141). The proof is a complete computation: an element of the stalk is described by a triple modulo the equivalence relation, with the author noting that chains of identities are needed in general (proof lines 8144-8151); every triple is shown to be equivalent to the canonical representative with the representing object and the identity morphism, and equivalent triples give the same canonical representative (proof lines 8151-8154); whence the displayed map is bijective (proof lines 8155-8157). The non-formal content is the reduction to the canonical representative. The claim is H1: a written-out computation.
